text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—I want to run away. From the name of 
Mejiro. And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Without caring about how others see me, I 
want to live true to myself. Because I am 
who I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Well, yeah, I mean, that's true! If it 
were that easy, nobody'd break a sweat 
over it, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, living life pushing yourself into 
the spotlight takes serious confidence, 
doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's not that easy to just act confident, 
you know. I mean, the Mejiro family is 
full of so many sparkling, amazing 
Umamusume...

—The prestigious Mejiro family of the 
Umamusume world. Indeed, it was home to 
many Umamusume regarded as promising 
talents.

Take Mejiro McQueen, who aims to be the 
strongest stayer, or Mejiro Ryan, the 
muscular, rising star...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, it is almost time for the 
inter-house matches. Mejiro versus the 
other families.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Our only goal is total victory! Not just 
for me and you, of course, but for all the 
other Mejiro Umamusume as well!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
An undefeated sweep~...!? Awawawa, isn't 
that asking for a bit too much...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I bet some of the girls won't be able to 
keep up and will end up exhausted... What 
should we do~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, easy, easy, McQueen! No need to get 
all huffy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Ryan, I'll go support the 
other girls. Leave the backstage work to 
me and focus on your match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It was always my job to keep the peace. 
Soothing McQueen, helping Ryan out. But 
that was...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Less about being considerate, more like... 
she's doing her absolute best to show off, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Smoothly managing the room was what I 
could do for the Mejiros, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
McQueen has unmatched stamina, and Ryan 
has incredible speed. All I could really 
contribute was charm, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's necessary, right? Every family needs 
at least one mediator girl like that. And 
that girl is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Once I take a step outside, I'm just a 
completely ordinary, unremarkable 
Umamusume with nothing special to show for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I'll ask one more time, were 
you really okay with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to jump ship, now's the time. 
I'm pretty understanding, so it's not like 
I'll get mad."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you want to run in the 
Twinkle Series with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiros don't expect anything from me 
either, and I always end up trying to read 
the room... Even so?
choice_data_list: Ah, I want to leave your name in history

Yeah, I want to leave your name in 
history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, ahaha! Are you like that too? The 
type who just can't leave someone alone, 
like me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Just let me say one thing, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
These feelings aren't a lie. This desire 
to 'live more true to myself.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Until now, all I thought about was 'I have 
to act like a proper Mejiro.' But!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I've gotta become an even bigger and 
better version of myself! Alright, time to 
stay positive and blast away in an 
explosive runaway lead~!"

Mejiro Palmer. Among the blooming 
brilliance of the Mejiro family, she is 
one of the less prominent Umamusume.

I continued to cling to the traditional, 
dignified running style fitting of the 
Mejiro family, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Ahhh, dammit, dead last...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No way! If a Mejiro Umamusume acts like 
this, everyone will—"

Results didn't come easily. But then came 
that day when she ran in a freestyle race 
outside of Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I... should give it a try too...? 
Yeah... this is a place where I'm allowed 
to run freely...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright! This time I'm definitely going to 
break away, just you watch!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Watch me win... Everyone, every single one 
of you! Burn this into your memories--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaahhhhhーーーtttt!!!!

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Paaal-meeeer! Paaal-meeeer! Paaal-meeeer! 
Paaal-meeeer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, how could this... haha, are you 
serious? ...This is so, crazy. My name 
is... Like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank youuuu!! I feel so freaaaaaking 
goooood--!!

Casting aside all constraints and running 
freely with her "explosive front-runner" 
style, her talent finally blossomed.

And birds of a feather flock together. The 
one who became a good friend to Mejiro 
Palmer as a fellow runaway front-runner 
was—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
‘Sup, ‘sup! Bestie Palmer-chin☆ Way-yo, 
yo☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yo, yo, Helios! My sun!! My Twinkle Series 
debut is finally happening!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
F-For real!? Fr fr!? Has the time to 
spread my wings finally come~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's totally the anniversary! Talk about 
mega super hype-licious☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
FuFu~~~â Besties, let's strike a pose 
right away!!" Kathy

This Umamusume is Daitaku Helios. A dear 
friend and benefactor who taught Mejiro 
Palmer the joy of running an upbeat, 
exhilarating front-runner race.

Lately, their bond has only grown deeper 
and deeper. As a result...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer. Where should we aim for my 
Make a Debut, for now? Distance 
variation-wise...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heh, ah, my bad~... Sorry, sorry. That was 
pretty rude of me, wasn't it...
choice_data_list: No, in fact, let's go with that.
No, let's actually go with that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? By that, you mean... In party-people 
slang!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, basically the Mejiro family's gyaru.
Yeah, I'm the Mejiro family's gal, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A gal from the Mejiro family?! ...For 
real?! Uh, wait, are you actually 
serious?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds totally fab, super vibes♪ Party 
animal Palmer is way more lively than 
shy-cat Palmer, for real☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Runaway sprint to the max, then interview 
in party-girl slang! That'll leave a 
massive mark, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds pretty awesome! A 
victory interview in party-people slang!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"You'd have to be completely out of your 
mind to do something like that. But..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I pull this off, my name will go down 
in history~. As Palmer, the one who ran 
free without being crushed under the 
weight of the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-Are we gonna do this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gonna blow 'em away, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Get hype, stay hype, yarirafy～☆ That is 
so whoooo～～～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're right. I'm going to break 
away—from my serious self, from the Mejiro 
common sense...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've decided! I'm gonna run as 
the gal of the Mejiro family! And I'm 
gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"And I'll make a name for myself by being 
true to who I am. Not the Mejiro way—but 
as Palmer!"

The goal was set. Mejiro Palmer won't just 
win; she'll aim for the top as the Mejiro 
party girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this. With Trainer, 
and my bestie Helios!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Reading the room? Who cares! I'm gonna 
explosive-front-run straight into 
tomorrow! Wooohoo! Fuuu~~!!
